about_short_description.short_description: Fakeeh.Care specializes in internal medicine, urology, ENT, cardiology, surgery, dental, dermatology, and diagnostic services.

product.name: Hospital and Tertiary Care Services
product.description: Inpatient and outpatient medical care delivered through Fakeeh hospitals in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, including internal medicine, surgery, cardiology, urology, ENT, dental, dermatology, and diagnostic services.

product.name: Fakeeh University Hospital – Dubai
product.description: A university-affiliated hospital in Dubai providing multidisciplinary inpatient, outpatient, surgical, emergency, and diagnostic services through 350 beds and 55 outpatient clinics.

product.name: Dr. Soliman Fakeeh Hospital Network
product.description: A network of hospitals in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Madinah delivering specialist, tertiary, surgical, emergency, inpatient, outpatient, and diagnostic care.

product.name: Ambulatory and Medical Center Services
product.description: Outpatient consultations, follow-up care, preventive services, and selected procedures delivered through Fakeeh Medical, Fakeeh Medical Home, executive clinics, and Dr. Soliman Fakeeh Medical Centers.

product.name: Diagnostic Services
product.description: Laboratory, imaging, and other diagnostic services used to assess medical conditions, support clinical decisions, and monitor treatment.

product.name: Fakeeh Home Health Care
product.description: Home-based healthcare and support services for patients who require care, monitoring, or assistance outside a hospital or clinic.
